Alex K: Hey team — just finished HR onboarding. I don't have a HubSpot seat, Gong invite, or Dialpad extension yet. Also can't access the demo sandbox. Who should I ping for these?
Jordan (Sales Ops): Welcome Alex! Ping me. I can request HubSpot + Gong seats. Can you paste your work email and manager?
Alex K: alex.k@redwood.ai, manager: Priya S. Thanks!
Jordan (Sales Ops): Got it. Quick checklist I need to submit to IT:```Full name: Alex K
Work email: alex.k@redwood.ai
Manager: Priya S
Role: Sales - AE
Start date: 2026-03-23
Seats needed: HubSpot (Sales Rep), Gong (Call Recording), Dialpad (Agent)```
Alex K: pasted. Anything else for the sandbox?
Priya S (Sales Enablement): Hey Alex — I’ll add you to #sales-resources. For the sandbox we use demo credentials (read-only) and a personal sandbox for playbook practice. Jordan, can you also create a sandbox account and tag it with "ae-onboard"?
Jordan (Sales Ops): On it. Submitting provisioning ticket now. @OnboardingBot can you kick off the flow?
OnboardingBot: Provisioning request submitted by Jordan (Sales Ops). Ticket #RB-20260323-58. Estimated completion: ~30–90 minutes.
Taylor (CS): Alex — once HubSpot/Gong are live, ping me and I’ll send call scripts and the CS handoff checklist. Also recommend this quick checklist: 1) Confirm call recording is enabled, 2) Verify contact syncing to HubSpot, 3) Test Dialpad outbound.
Jordan (Sales Ops): Update: HubSpot seat provisioned and invite sent. Gong invite sent (check spam). Dialpad extension queued — should be active within the hour. Sandbox account created: demo-alex@redwood-sandbox.io — temporary link sent via email.
Alex K: Awesome, thanks everyone!
Priya S (Sales Enablement): Added you to the "Sales Quickstarts" doc in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/sales/quickstarts — includes pitch deck, objection handling, and the role-specific playbook. We'll schedule a 30-min ramp sync later today.
Alex K: Scheduled — saw the calendar invite. One last Q: where are the Gong highlight templates?
Taylor (CS): In the Sales Tools folder on Drive: /Sales/Enablement/Gong-Templates. I'll DM you two sample templates to get started.
Alex K: Perfect. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
Jordan (Sales Ops): Closing ticket RB-20260323-58 when Dialpad finishes provisioning. Reach out if anything else breaks.
